claim: Clinically interpretable targets can serve as candidate shared coordinates when they are recoverable and reproducible
Morphology-linked grade and phenotype have the broadest available cross-cohort alignment support
PTEN-related information is recoverable within TCGA-PRAD but grade-independent increment and external transport are not established
AR activity has positive pooled alignment but grade-independent increment and site transport remain unresolved
SPOP is unsupported in the frozen primary design and setting sensitive without implying biological absence
Recurrence alignment is endpoint representation and covariate hierarchy conditioned
Encoder scale tile and seed audits bound sensitivity but do not rank encoders or supply independent replication
Two internal BCR heads were sensitive to an ISUP-correlated representation direction beyond variance-matched random directions
ISUP-correlated sensitivity did not establish indispensable use; a limited internal ISUP-only comparison did not establish incremental prognostic value
Residual or unknown AI features are not marker claims in the present manuscript
